content: Supabase Storage Node.js: createClient(url, serviceRoleKey) bypasses RLS. Upload: supabase.storage.from('bucket').upload('path/file.mp4', buffer, { contentType: 'video/mp4', upsert: true }). Signed URL: supabase.storage.from('bucket').createSignedUrl('path/file.mp4', expiresInSeconds) returns { data: { signedUrl }, error }. expiresIn is in SECONDS (e.g. 86400 for 24h). Service role key must NEVER reach browser. Store in SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY env var. Worker should use a separate admin client.
